discoveryCoverage: Two source nodes identified during the bounded reading of Conrad scenes; no claim of complete game-wide discovery, reverse callers or runtime reachability.

cases.title: Ambiguous special endings and explicit clarification
cases.observedSourceBehavior: Conrad uses the phrase special endings in two separate nodes. In Conrad_required_1 one option takes the words at face value, provoking his correction and explicit explanation; another asks directly about sexual services. Each has distinct responses, follow-up choices and shared continuation. Conrad_1 separately asks a similar question with three other branches.
cases.invariant: Preserve the initially ambiguous euphemism, the player's literal response in its branch, Conrad's subsequent clarification, the direct-question alternative, character voice, and every distinct choice and destination. Avoid assuming the two nodes are both naturally reachable.
cases.adaptationRoute: After source and glossary readiness, decide and review the actual Russian euphemism, literal response, clarification and alternatives as one dependency group before ordinary translation.
cases.nonTextDependencies: Both source programs' instruction bytes, dialogue and facial commands, source markup and tested rendering. Player address follows the approved neutral strategy. Actual reachability, timing and runtime presentation remain unverified.
acceptanceScenarios: The literal response produces Conrad's correction before the explicit explanation; the direct response follows its own continuation.
The three choices in Conrad_1 retain their separate original destinations.
Reject wording that makes the literal response unrelated to the euphemism or changes the meaning of the explicit alternative.
